'''1999 Star Wars Celebration EPP Overdrive''' was the Saturday [[EPP Overdrive]] tournament at Star Wars Celebration I in Denver, 1 May 1999. [[Chris Hines]] took first. The Information Broker ([[Tim Guzman]]) recorded the result in his Celebration report on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="or-cel">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Celebrationreport.htm Star Wars Celebration Report], The Outer Rim (The Information Broker). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261029234045/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Celebrationreport.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
